guard: persona catalog readers answer for the resolved mesh root rather than the cwd
why: FIVE MUTATIONS cover the catalog, mint's shipped persona read, the B2 refusal, signing source,
and default credential storage. Making personasDir ignore its required root
sends every shared reader back to process.cwd(): personas list and the completers describe the
folder the operator stands in while spawn still launches from the selected mesh's catalog.
The mutation is compile-clean and the smoke drives the real personas command before comparing
its printed answer with spawn's product reader. It must redden `catalog: personas list prints the
MESH's personas`; a general non-zero or a different failing cell is not accepted as proof.
The mint mutations all alter SHIPPED mint.ts. One restores the cwd persona read, one disables the
cross-root authority refusal, one restores cwd signing authority while retaining target ACLs, and
one restores cwd default storage. Each has a distinct named cell. Together they prove the command
does not merely resolve the right root at a seam: ACL, signing, refusal and storage use it end to end.

mutations.name: the persona catalog ignores the resolved root and reads from the cwd
mutations.expectRed: catalog: personas list prints the MESH's personas
mutations.cell: catalog: personas list prints the MESH's personas
mutations.note: This exact substitution keeps TypeScript green while restoring the silent cwd fallback the required root argument removed.

mutations.name: mint reads the persona ACL from the cwd after resolving the target mesh
mutations.expectRed: mint: the credential carries the MESH card's channel, not the cwd card's
mutations.cell: mint: the credential carries the MESH card's channel, not the cwd card's
mutations.note: This changes the shipped mint call site, not resolveMintTarget or a test-only restatement, and remains type-correct.

mutations.name: mint ignores conflicting cwd trust instead of refusing the incoherent authority
mutations.replace: if (false && cwdAuth && (!auth || cwdAuth.space !== resolvedTarget.space || cwdAuth.account.pub !== auth.account.pub)) {
mutations.expectRed: mint: a cwd trust root that differs from the selected mesh authority is REFUSED
mutations.cell: mint: a cwd trust root that differs from the selected mesh authority is REFUSED
mutations.note: This compile-clean mutation reverts only the new B2 refusal guard and lets the exact conflicting-root input proceed.

mutations.name: mint signs from cwd trust while reading ACLs from the selected mesh root
mutations.expectRed: mint: a cwd trust root that differs from the selected mesh authority is REFUSED
mutations.cell: mint: a cwd trust root that differs from the selected mesh authority is REFUSED
mutations.note: This is the B2 mixed-authority defect itself: selected-root persona ACLs plus cwd signing material.

mutations.name: mint stores the default credential under cwd instead of the selected mesh root
mutations.expectRed: mint: default credential storage does NOT use the cwd root
mutations.cell: mint: default credential storage does NOT use the cwd root
mutations.note: The target-root output is still materialized, but the source-of-truth store also writes the cwd copy, which the named cell detects.
